_doc: Walks to a goal (generated by tools/trails/goal_walks.py from OpenStreetMap, ODbL, and the Copernicus DEM; never edit by hand).

trails.name: Coropuna summit
trails.why: Coropuna is a dormant compound volcano located in the Andes mountains of southeast-central Peru.

trails.name: Copa summit
trails.why: Copa is a mountain in the Andes of Peru whose summit reaches about 6,188 metres above sea level.

trails.name: Chachani Volcano summit
trails.why: Chachani is a volcanic complex in southern Peru, 22 kilometres northwest of the city of Arequipa.

trails.name: Pisco summit
trails.why: Pisco is a mountain in Peru, located in the Cordillera Blanca about 60 km north of Huaraz.

trails.name: Ishinca summit
trails.why: Nevado Ishinca, meaning "snow covered mountain", is a mountain peak located in the Cordillera Blanca mountain range in the Peruvian Andes.

trails.name: Yanapaccha summit
trails.why: Yanapaccha is a mountain in the Cordillera Blanca in the Andes of Peru, about 5,460 metres high.

trails.name: Urus summit
trails.why: Urus, also known as Yanaraju, is a 5,423-metre-high mountain in the Cordillera Blanca in the Andes of Peru.

trails.name: Vicos summit
trails.why: Vicos or Paccharuri is a 5,315 m high mountain in the Cordillera Blanca in the Andes of Peru.

trails.name: Sinqa summit
trails.why: Sinqa is a 4,423-metre-high mountain in the Andes of Peru northwest of the city of Cusco. It lies in the Cusco Region, Cusco Province, Cusco District, and in the Anta Province, Cachimayo District.

trails.name: Putaqa Hirka summit
trails.why: Putaqa Hirka is a mountain in the eastern extensions of the Cordillera Blanca in the Andes of Peru which reaches a height of approximately 4,200 m.

trails.name: Rajucollota summit
trails.why: Rajucollota, Suerococha, named after the nearby lake, or Diablo Mudo is a mountain in the west of the Huayhuash mountain range in the Andes of Peru, about 5,427 metres high.

trails.name: Waman Wayi summit
trails.why: Waman Wayi is a mountain in the Andes of Peru which reaches a height of approximately 4,400 m.

trails.name: Catarata de Huacamaillo waterfall
trails.why: Huacamaillo Falls is a waterfall in San Antonio district, San Martín, Peru.

trails.name: Refugio Contrahierbas
trails.why: The Contrahierbas refuge is a mountain hut at 4,200 m below Nevado Cajavilca in Huascarán National Park.

trails.name: Huacratanca summit
trails.why: Huacratanca is a 5,024-metre-high mountain in the Urubamba mountain range in the Andes of Peru.

trails.name: Qispirumiyuq summit
trails.why: Qhispi Rumiyuq (Quechua qhispi rumi, obsidian, -yuq a suffix to indicate ownership, "the one with obsidian", Hispanicized spelling Quesperumiyoc) is a mountain in the Cusco Region in Peru, about 4,059 metres high.

trails.name: Laguna de los Cóndores
trails.why: Laguna de las Momias, also known as Laguna de los Cóndores is an archaeological site located in Leimebamba, in the province of Chachapoyas in the Amazonas Region of Peru, excavated by the archaeologist Federico Kauffmann Doig.

trails.name: Juraucocha lake
trails.why: Huraw lake lies in the Huayhuash range in Cajatambo province, Lima region, at the foot of the snowy Yantauri peak.

trails.name: Laguna Mitococha
trails.why: Lake Mitococha or Mitucocha is a lake in Peru located in Huanuco Region, Lauricocha Province, Queropalca District.

trails.name: Laguna Ichiccocha
trails.why: Lake Ichiccocha or Lake Chica is a lake in the Cordillera Blanca in the Andes of Peru located in Ancash Region, Huaylas Province, Santa Cruz District.

trails.name: Laguna Mamacocha
trails.why: Lake Mamacocha is a lake in Peru located in the Huánuco Region, Huacaybamba Province, Pinra District.

trails.name: Laguna Lejiacocha
trails.why: Lejiacocha is a lake in the Cordillera Blanca in the Andes of Peru at 4,706 metres of elevation.

trails.name: Nahuincocha lake
trails.why: Ñawinqucha is a lake in Peru located in the Huancavelica Region, Huancavelica Province, Acobambilla District.

trails.name: Laguna Auxilio
trails.why: Awkillu lake lies in the Huayhuash range of the Andes, in Bolognesi province, Áncash, Peru.

trails.name: Laguna Ahuac near Huaraz
trails.why: Laguna Ahuac is a freshwater lake in Huascarán National Park, in the Cordillera Blanca above the Callejón de Huaylas, Áncash.

trails.name: Laguna Tambococha
trails.why: Lake Tambococha is a lake in Peru located in the Huanuco Region, Lauricocha Province, at the border of the districts Cauri and Jesús.

trails.name: Hatun Pucacocha lake
trails.why: Jatun Pucacocha (possibly from Quechua hatun big / superior / principal, puka red, qucha lake, "big red lake") is a lake in Peru located in the Cusco Region, Quispicanchi Province, Ocongate District.

trails.name: Singrenacocha lake
trails.why: Lake Singrenacocha or Sigrenacocha is a lake in Peru located in the Cusco Region, Quispicanchi Province, Ocongate District.

trails.name: Laguna Casacocha
trails.why: Q'asaqucha is a lake in Peru located in the Lima Region, Huaura Province, Santa Leonor District.

trails.name: Hatunqucha lake
trails.why: Hatunqucha (Quechua hatun big, large qucha lake, "big lake", Hispanicized names Cocha Grande, Cochagrande, Jatunccocha, Jatuncocha) is a lake in the Waytapallana mountain range in the Andes of Peru.

trails.name: Laguna Auquishcocha
trails.why: Lake Auquiscocha or Auquishcocha is a lake in the Cordillera Blanca in the Andes of Peru located in the Ancash Region, Carhuaz Province, Shilla District.

trails.name: Yanacocha lake near Ollantaytambo
trails.why: Yanacocha is a lake in Peru located in the Cusco Region, Urubamba Province, Huaylllabamba District.
